artifact.name: simulator-root-closure
artifact.purpose: Adjudicate eleven high-fan-in Simulator roots, preserve bounded ambiguities, and define characterization-only Phase-1 packages.

snapshot.evidence_boundary: No OBSERVED or VERIFIED claim is made. SDK declarations provide type/layout provenance; pinned bytes, xrefs, and committed static analyses provide mechanics. No trace, boot oracle, or differential result was used.

confirmed_or_strong_static_contracts: 00b3d350 is the named Simulator::cGameInputManager::Get accessor with a confirmed field map and separate input/mode state.
01021260 and 01021080 are the null-guarded active-planet and unguarded SpaceContext read views over Simulator::sSpacePlayerData.
00b1fdb0 returns a raw cCreatureBase/cCreatureAnimal pointer read from receiver+0x54; receiver+0x54 is strongly cGameNounManager::mpAvatar storage.
00b21340 is the actual cGameNounManager::GetData implementation; 00b212d0 is a split continuation label/misclassified xref from 00b211e0, not a second implementation.
01021300 is a validated current-player cEmpire cache with exact AddRef/store/Release ordering and lower-bound successor caching.
00ba9370 is the cStarManager mEmpires unsigned lower-bound/ceiling lookup, not exact-find.
00b25fb0's normal path resolves a cCivilization-compatible cGameData pointer through 00b25f40 and kCivilization; its exact SDK method name remains bounded.
00b3d300 and 00b3d2a0 are strong alternate manager-pointer accessors, not generic service locators.
still_unresolved: 00b5b800 has closed forwarding mechanics but no concrete receiver class, mode/strategy identity, or physical storage type.
Alternate/canonical noun and star manager slots are not proven equal, and their publication/lifecycle is unresolved.

remaining_ambiguities: Whether DAT_0167eae0 aliases DAT_0167eb60 and DAT_0167eae4 aliases DAT_0167eb0c at every lifecycle point.
The concrete receiver and lifetime behind DAT_0167eaec and forwarded_object+0x20.
One ECX source for 00b1fdb0 at 00bff2d0:00bff3b4, supplied by 01002bd0 rather than 00b3d300.
Whole-object teardown and final global release for Simulator::sSpacePlayerData.
Allocation failure, invalidation, erase, and concurrency behavior in noun materialization.
Exact SDK identity and no-empire return semantics of 00b25fb0.
newly_recovered_structures_and_types: Full cGameNounManager 0x11c layout relevant to mpAvatar, mpPlayer, mNouns, mNounMap, mPoliticalMap, and mObjects.
Complete tGameDataVectorT<cGameData> 0x18 layout including mGarbage and mAllocator.
cGameData 0x34 political/list/refcount layout and cCivilization 0x4d8 subtype boundary.
cCreatureBase/cCreatureAnimal return layout, including result vtable slot +0xd8, cLocomotiveObject subobject +0xc0, species profile +0xb20, and field +0xb5c.
SpacePlayerData 0x34 allocation, initialization, active planet/star replacement, context normalization, and field teardown contracts.
cStarManager mEmpires +0x150 and relationship-manager +0x204; cEmpire AddRef/Release and mPoliticalID contracts.
EASTL unsigned lower-bound map behavior and its successor hazard.

newly_understandable_callers.scope: The forty-caller set is the conservative union explicitly selected in the cross-root artifact. The 2,303-caller union is mechanically constrained by a root call/return contract, not semantically understood in full.

downstream_function_counts.mechanical_meaning: Every direct caller receives a statically established root calling/return contract.
downstream_function_counts.semantic_limit: The mechanical population is not a claim that every caller, conditional path, object identity, or runtime behavior is fully understood.

executive_summary.phase1_boundary: All listed packages produce contracts, matrices, typed observations, and stopping conditions only. None authorizes replacements or begins Phase 1.
